mapper.select: select count(*) from user_question_progress progress join question on question.id = progress.question_id and question.status = 'ACTIVE' where progress.user_id = #{userId} and progress.status = 'WRONG'
select question_id from user_sequential_progress where user_id = #{userId} and scope_key = #{scopeKey}
mapper.insert: insert into user_sequential_progress (user_id, scope_key, question_id, updated_at) values (#{userId}, #{scopeKey}, #{questionId}, current_timestamp) on conflict (user_id, scope_key) do update set question_id = excluded.question_id, updated_at = current_timestamp
